items.title: Potential of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms for Identification of Relevant Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Early-Stage Liver Cancer
items.abstract_or_text: This study explores the use of deep learning and explainable artificial intelligence to diagnose hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and define effective biomarkers across five different stages of disease development using a transcriptomic biomarker HCC dataset constructed via semi-supervised learning from three source datasets. Several deep learning experiments were conducted with different feature extraction techniques and gene sets to identify the most effective features for training high-accuracy models with minimal loss. The best-performing model, using 15 selected genes with the SelectKBest algorithm, achieved 90.74% accuracy, while the model with the lowest recorded loss of 0.3187 was obtained using 20 selected genes. To address the issue of class imbalance in the dataset, a weighted training approach was conducted, and for model transparency and interpretability a SHAP-based XAI analysis provided insights into the model's decision-making, consistently finding DNAJB14 as the most influential gene. Functional validation in this study has provided compelling evidence that DNAJB14 plays an important role in the adverse properties of HCC and that its inhibition effectively reverses tumour cell migration, invasion, colony and sphere formation. The main limitation of this study is the dataset's class imbalance, and while weighted training helped mitigate this, further research and additional data are needed to guarantee model generalizability. Future studies should also explore the influence of genetic variations, environmental factors, and clinical differences on model performance across diverse populations.
items.summary_zh: 研究以三个来源数据集经半监督学习构建的 HCC 转录组标志物数据集训练深度学习模型；15 基因 SelectKBest 模型准确率为 90.74%，并以 SHAP 和功能实验将 DNAJB14 列为重点候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将转录组预测、可解释性分析与细胞功能验证连接起来；但数据类别不平衡，且尚需更大、更多样化的人群验证其泛化性。
items.abstract_zh: 本研究探索使用深度学习和可解释人工智能诊断肝细胞癌（HCC），并在疾病发展的五个不同阶段界定有效生物标志物；所用 HCC 转录组标志物数据集由三个源数据集经半监督学习构建。研究以不同特征提取技术和基因集进行了多项深度学习实验，以识别能以最小损失训练高准确率模型的最有效特征。性能最佳的模型使用 SelectKBest 算法选出的 15 个基因，准确率达到 90.74%；记录到最低损失 0.3187 的模型则使用了 20 个选定基因。为处理数据集类别不平衡问题，研究采用加权训练方法；为提升模型透明度和可解释性，基于 SHAP 的 XAI 分析揭示了模型决策过程，并一致发现 DNAJB14 是影响最大的基因。本研究的功能验证为 DNAJB14 在 HCC 不良特性中发挥重要作用提供了有力证据，且抑制 DNAJB14 可有效逆转肿瘤细胞迁移、侵袭、克隆形成和球体形成。该研究的主要局限性是数据集类别不平衡；尽管加权训练有助于缓解这一问题，仍需要进一步研究和更多数据来保证模型的泛化性。未来研究还应探索遗传变异、环境因素和临床差异对不同人群模型性能的影响。
items.author_line: Ali Bou Nassif, Darko Castven, Manar Abu Talib, Jibran Sualeh Muhammad, Ahmed Ammar Kubba, Jens Marquardt, Abdalla Sayed Ali

items.title: Countering Neural Activity Drift: Sustained Long-term Seizure Prediction Using an Evolutionary Machine-Learning Framework on Continuous Intracranial EEG
items.abstract_or_text: Objective: Seizure prediction in drug-resistant epilepsy remains a major biomedical challenge. Traditional machine learning approaches rely heavily on segmented offline testing, which suffers from artificial class rebalancing, hides neural activity drift over time, and severely inflates performance estimates. This study introduces an online evolutionary framework designed for realistic brain-computer interface validation and addresses performance degradation caused by neural drift. Methods: We present the first publicly available, continuous long-term stereoelectroencephalography dataset for seizure prediction, tracking 16 patients across 664.9 hours of data and 121 seizures. An offline combinatorial analysis evaluated pipeline decisions (referencing, frequency bands, functional connectivity metrics, and classifiers). The highest-performing offline elements, namely monopolar referencing, cross-correlation-based connectivity matrices, and Random Forests classifiers, were evaluated under realistic class imbalances in a pseudo-prospective online framework. Candidate models (N = 1,000 per patient) were evolved across continuous streams, while a data-driven approach targeted patient-specific epileptogenic networks for input channel reduction. Results: Transitioning from offline to online evaluation demonstrated a prominent performance drop, with mean AUROC degrading from 90% to 57.9%, confirming offline metrics conceal temporal neural drift. However, our online evolutionary framework identified models achieving complete event-level seizure prediction in 75% of patients (and all but one seizure in 87.5%). Restricting inputs to the estimated epileptogenic network identified using our previously proposed approach reduced implanted contact requirements by 79.12% while providing superior predictive performance over clinically resected areas. Significance: This work demonstrates that actionable, deterministic seizure prediction is achievable when paired with modern computational capability. Because 1,000 candidate models represent a conservative proof-of-concept search budget, scaling search spaces in production environments can further expand optimal interictal sampling and prediction yields. By providing both a continuous benchmark dataset and a standardized online evaluation protocol, this framework offers a foundation for self-adapting closed-loop devices capable of post-event retraining and long-term deployment in clinical neuromodulatory.
items.summary_zh: 该研究公开连续长期立体脑电图数据集，覆盖 16 名患者、664.9 小时数据和 121 次发作，并以伪前瞻在线评估量化神经活动漂移对癫痫预测的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 连续流和真实类别不平衡设置揭示离线评估会高估性能，也为闭环神经调控的长期验证提供数据与协议；证据仍来自小样本预印本，不能等同于临床部署效果。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：药物难治性癫痫的发作预测仍是一项重大生物医学挑战。传统机器学习方法严重依赖分段式离线测试，这种测试存在人为类别再平衡、掩盖随时间变化的神经活动漂移，并严重夸大性能估计的问题。本研究提出一种为真实脑机接口验证而设计的在线进化框架，并解决由神经漂移导致的性能下降。方法：我们提出首个公开可用的、用于发作预测的连续长期立体脑电图数据集，追踪 16 名患者的 664.9 小时数据和 121 次发作。离线组合分析评估了流程决策，包括参考方式、频段、功能连接指标和分类器。在现实类别不平衡条件下，使用伪前瞻在线框架评估性能最高的离线要素，即单极参考、基于互相关的连接矩阵和随机森林分类器。候选模型（每名患者 N = 1,000）在连续数据流中进化；同时，数据驱动方法针对患者特异性致痫网络进行输入通道缩减。结果：从离线评估转换为在线评估后，平均 AUROC 从 90% 降至 57.9%，显示离线指标掩盖了时间性神经漂移。然而，在线进化框架在 75% 的患者中识别出实现全部事件级发作预测的模型，并在 87.5% 的患者中预测到除一次外的所有发作。将输入限制为使用我们此前提出的方法估计的致痫网络后，植入接触点需求减少 79.12%，且预测性能优于临床切除区域。意义：本工作表明，当与现代计算能力结合时，可操作、确定性的发作预测是可实现的。由于 1,000 个候选模型代表保守的概念验证搜索预算，在生产环境中扩大搜索空间可进一步扩展最佳发作间期采样和预测收益。通过提供连续基准数据集和标准化在线评估协议，该框架为能够在事件后再训练并长期部署于临床神经调控中的自适应闭环装置奠定基础。
items.author_line: Montoya-Galvez, J., Ivankovic, K., Nazari, M., Principe, A., Rocamora, R.

items.title: Agentic-AI-ready genome-wide poxvirus-host interaction screen refined by a protein language model
items.abstract_or_text: Recent mpox outbreaks highlight the necessity to understand the interactions between poxviruses and the human host. These can be discovered systematically through screening for host genes involved in infection at the single-cell level using RNA interference. However, off-target effects and assay noise obscure true gene-phenotype relationships, hampering the discovery of therapeutically relevant targets. Here, we show that integrating protein-protein interaction information derived from a protein language model boosts the discovery of vaccinia virus-host interactions. We propose ICARus - a positive-unlabelled read-out refinement framework to achieve this. Our approach enhances the identification of human genes with potential antiviral function. We provide the raw and refined read-outs of a genome-wide screen for vaccinia virus host factors as an agentic-AI-enabled community resource. Our findings provide a generalisable strategy for robust hit prioritisation in functional screens, accelerating discovery across complex biological systems.
items.summary_zh: ICARus 将蛋白质语言模型导出的蛋白—蛋白相互作用信息整合到全基因组 vaccinia virus 宿主因子 RNA 干扰筛选，并提供原始及经修正的筛选读出。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 面向 mpox 相关痘病毒宿主互作，工作针对功能筛选中的脱靶和噪声问题提出可复用的命中优先级方法；其治疗靶点价值尚待后续独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 近期 mpox 暴发表明，有必要理解痘病毒与人类宿主之间的相互作用。可通过 RNA 干扰在单细胞水平筛选参与感染的宿主基因，系统地发现这些相互作用。然而，脱靶效应和测定噪声会掩盖真实的基因—表型关系，阻碍发现具有治疗相关性的靶点。本文显示，整合由蛋白质语言模型导出的蛋白—蛋白相互作用信息，可提升 vaccinia virus—宿主相互作用的发现。我们提出 ICARus——一种正例—未标注读出修正框架——以实现这一目标。该方法增强了对具有潜在抗病毒功能的人类基因的识别。我们将 vaccinia virus 宿主因子的全基因组筛选原始和修正读出作为面向 Agentic AI 的社区资源提供。研究结果提出了一种可泛化策略，用于功能筛选中的稳健命中优先级排序，并加速复杂生物系统中的发现。
items.author_line: Anter J, Mercer J, Yakimovich A

items.title: CARDIAC-FM: A Generalizable Multimodal Foundation Model Integrating ECG and Cardiac MRI
items.abstract_or_text: Atrial fibrillation and heart failure impose substantial health burdens worldwide, yet accurate and generalizable risk prediction remains challenging. Here we developed CARDIAC-FM, a multimodal foundation model that integrates 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG) and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (cardiac MRI) through self-supervised representation learning and cross-modal contrastive alignment. CARDIAC-FM introduces a self-supervised spatiotemporal, multi-view masked autoencoder for cardiac MRI. Developed on 57,609 paired ECG-cardiac MRI samples from UK Biobank, CARDIAC-FM improved prediction of incident atrial fibrillation and heart failure over contemporary ECG AI models and generalized zero-shot to two external cohorts, the Cardiovascular Health Study and the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis. Combining its ECG representation with established clinical risk scores further improved discrimination across cohorts, supporting complementary prognostic information from ECG and traditional risk factors. Beyond atrial fibrillation and heart failure, the learned representation transferred to continuous cardiac MRI phenotype prediction, time-to-event modelling and prediction of additional cardiovascular outcomes with limited fine-tuning, including myocardial infarction, ischaemic stroke, cardiovascular death and all-cause mortality. Although pre-trained with paired ECG and cardiac MRI, the model can be deployed using ECG alone, with additional predictive gains when cardiac MRI is available. These findings demonstrate the promise of multimodal self-supervised learning for generalizable cardiovascular risk prediction.
items.summary_zh: CARDIAC-FM 在 57,609 对 UK Biobank ECG—心脏 MRI 样本上预训练，并报告对房颤和心力衰竭风险预测的改进及在两个外部队列中的零样本泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模配对多模态预训练加外部队列评估，为 ECG 与心脏 MRI 融合的可迁移风险预测提供较强证据；仍是预印本中的预测研究，不证明临床获益。
items.abstract_zh: 心房颤动和心力衰竭在全球造成沉重健康负担，但准确且可泛化的风险预测仍具挑战性。本文开发了 CARDIAC-FM，这是一种多模态基础模型，通过自监督表征学习和跨模态对比对齐整合 12 导联心电图（ECG）与心脏磁共振成像（心脏 MRI）。CARDIAC-FM 引入了用于心脏 MRI 的自监督时空多视图掩码自编码器。在来自 UK Biobank 的 57,609 对 ECG—心脏 MRI 样本上开发后，CARDIAC-FM 对新发心房颤动和心力衰竭的预测优于当代 ECG AI 模型，并可零样本泛化至两个外部队列，即 Cardiovascular Health Study 和 Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis。将其 ECG 表征与既有临床风险评分结合，进一步改善了各队列的区分能力，支持 ECG 与传统风险因素提供互补的预后信息。除心房颤动和心力衰竭外，所学习的表征还能迁移至连续心脏 MRI 表型预测、时间至事件建模，以及在有限微调下预测其他心血管结局，包括心肌梗死、缺血性卒中、心血管死亡和全因死亡。尽管使用配对 ECG 和心脏 MRI 进行预训练，该模型可仅用 ECG 部署；在有心脏 MRI 时可获得额外预测增益。这些结果表明，多模态自监督学习有望用于可泛化的心血管风险预测。
items.author_line: Li, F., Li, S., Chen, B., Qian, Y., Brody, J. A., Yogeswaran, V., Wiggins, K. L., Sitlani, C. M., Bis, J. C., Shojaie, A., Longstreth, W. T., Psaty, B. M., Tison, G. H., Du, S., Floyd, J. S., Ye, T.

items.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate genome-wide prediction of transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding remains challenging because many models focus mainly on DNA sequence and overlook chromatin context and TF structure. We previously developed TransBind, a protein-aware model that combines TF and DNA representations through cross-attention. Here, we introduce TransBind2, which improves on TransBind in several ways. It incorporates DNase-seq accessibility and genome mappability tracks as additional input, uses a biomodal protein language model (ProstT5) to capture both TF sequence and structure, and applies bidirectional cross-attention so DNA and protein features can refine each other. We also frame prediction as binary classification of individual triplets, allowing the model to generalize to new TFs and cell types. Across 690 human ChIP-seq experiments covering 161 TFs and 91 cell types, TransBind2 achieves a macro AUROC of 0.9648 and AUPR of 0.4215, outperforming TransBind and other baselines, with a ≥12.67% relative AUPR gain. The model trained on human data also performs well in cross-species zero-shot prediction on mouse data. Saliency analysis shows that it can identify TF-binding peaks with a median error of 12-38 base pairs (bps) despite being trained on window-level labels. Ablation studies further show that TF structure, chromatin accessibility, and bidirectional attention each improve performance. Overall, these results show that combining TF structure with chromatin context leads to more accurate and generalizable TF-DNA binding predictions.
items.summary_zh: TransBind2 将 DNase-seq 可及性、基因组可比对性、ProstT5 的 TF 序列—结构表示与双向交叉注意力结合，在 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验中报告宏平均 AUROC 0.9648。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型将蛋白结构与染色质语境共同用于 TF-DNA 结合预测，并给出跨物种零样本和消融评估；当前结论仍限于计算基准性能。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的全基因组转录因子（TF）-DNA 结合预测仍具挑战性，因为许多模型主要关注 DNA 序列，而忽略染色质语境和 TF 结构。我们此前开发了 TransBind，这是一种通过交叉注意力结合 TF 和 DNA 表示的蛋白质感知模型。本文介绍 TransBind2，其在多个方面改进了 TransBind。它将 DNase-seq 可及性和基因组可比对性轨道作为附加输入，使用双模态蛋白质语言模型（ProstT5）同时捕获 TF 序列和结构，并应用双向交叉注意力，使 DNA 和蛋白质特征能够彼此细化。我们还将预测表述为单个三元组的二分类任务，使模型可泛化至新的 TF 和细胞类型。在覆盖 161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型的 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验中，TransBind2 达到 0.9648 的宏平均 AUROC 和 0.4215 的 AUPR，优于 TransBind 和其他基线，AUPR 相对提升至少 12.67%。在小鼠数据上，该模型在由人类数据训练后的跨物种零样本预测中也表现良好。显著性分析表明，尽管模型以窗口级标签训练，它仍能以 12-38 个碱基对（bps）的中位误差识别 TF 结合峰。消融研究进一步表明，TF 结构、染色质可及性和双向注意力各自均能提升性能。总体而言，这些结果表明，将 TF 结构与染色质语境结合可带来更准确且更具泛化性的 TF-DNA 结合预测。

items.title: Heterogeneous graph neural networks with biological prior knowledge for interpretable drug repurposing in triple-negative breast cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Drug repurposing offers a cost-effective path to new therapies for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), a subtype with limited targeted treatment options. We present PRECISION, a framework integrating transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks, protein-protein interactions, and drug-target edges into a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) to identify TFs mediating drug sensitivity and prioritize repurposing candidates. The knowledge graph has 23,498 nodes and approximately 830,000 edges from CollecTRI, OmniPath and the PRISM screen. In a fair cell-line hold-out evaluation, the GNN matches ML baselines in global prediction (Pearson r = 0.76). Per-drug mechanistic attributions via Integrated Gradients on the trained GNN, replicated across three independent training seeds and robust to baseline choice (Spearman's rho = 0.94 between the mean and the random Gaussian baselines), highlight stress-response (CREB3L1), epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT; KLF8, ZEB1), stromal/TNBC-specific (AEBP1, MZF1), and epithelial (SPDEF) regulators as stable mediators of drug response. Multi-cohort validation in SCAN-B (n = 7,397), METABRIC (n = 1,979), and TCGA-BRCA (n = 1,072) shows that predicted drug sensitivity is associated with overall survival in 623 drugs in SCAN-B and 74 in METABRIC (FDR < 0.05). Fisher's meta-analysis identifies 551 drugs at FDR < 0.05, validated by positive controls paclitaxel (p_adj = 8.6x10-3), docetaxel (3.1x10-2), epirubicin (3.2x10-6), and talazoparib (1.4x10-4). Paired Wilcoxon tests in 39 AURORA-US patients with matched primary and metastatic samples confirm that 4 of the 10 IG-identified TFs (CREB3L1, KLF8, AEBP1, SPDEF) are significantly altered during metastatic progression after Bonferroni correction. An explicit rule applied to the PAM50-adjusted Cox multivariate results (penalizer = 0.1) selects seven candidates (osimertinib, saracatinib, erlotinib, brigatinib, pelitinib, entinostat, trametinib), revealing pharmacological convergence on the EGFR signaling axis.
items.summary_zh: PRECISION 在 23,498 个节点、约 830,000 条边的异构知识图上整合调控网络、蛋白互作和药物—靶点边，用于三阴性乳腺癌药物再定位及机制归因。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作使用细胞系留出、多队列关联和转移配对样本评估，提出 EGFR 轴收敛的候选药物；生存关联和模型归因不构成药物疗效或机制因果证据。
items.abstract_zh: 药物再定位为三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）提供了通向新疗法的成本效益路径；TNBC 是一种靶向治疗选择有限的亚型。我们提出 PRECISION 框架，将转录因子（TF）调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合至异构图神经网络（GNN），以识别介导药物敏感性的 TF 并优先排序再定位候选物。该知识图谱包含 23,498 个节点和约 830,000 条边，数据来自 CollecTRI、OmniPath 和 PRISM 筛选。在公平的细胞系留出评估中，该 GNN 在全局预测上与 ML 基线相当（Pearson r = 0.76）。在训练后的 GNN 上采用 Integrated Gradients 进行逐药机制归因，且在三个独立训练随机种子中得到重复、并对基线选择稳健（平均基线与随机高斯基线之间的 Spearman's rho = 0.94）；结果突出显示应激反应（CREB3L1）、上皮—间质转化（EMT；KLF8、ZEB1）、基质/TNBC 特异性（AEBP1、MZF1）和上皮性（SPDEF）调控因子，是稳定的药物反应介导者。对 SCAN-B（n = 7,397）、METABRIC（n = 1,979）和 TCGA-BRCA（n = 1,072）进行多队列验证显示，在 SCAN-B 中，预测的药物敏感性与 623 种药物的总生存相关；在 METABRIC 中，与 74 种药物相关（FDR < 0.05）。Fisher Meta 分析识别出 551 种 FDR < 0.05 的药物，并由阳性对照 paclitaxel（p_adj = 8.6x10-3）、docetaxel（3.1x10-2）、epirubicin（3.2x10-6）和 talazoparib（1.4x10-4）验证。在 39 名具有配对原发和转移样本的 AURORA-US 患者中，配对 Wilcoxon 检验确认 10 个由 IG 识别的 TF 中有 4 个（CREB3L1、KLF8、AEBP1、SPDEF）在 Bonferroni 校正后于转移进程中显著改变。应用于 PAM50 校正 Cox 多变量结果的显式规则（penalizer = 0.1）选出七个候选物（osimertinib、saracatinib、erlotinib、brigatinib、pelitinib、entinostat、trametinib），显示药理学上向 EGFR 信号轴收敛。
items.author_line: Fernandez-Lozano C, Ferreiro D, V.-del-Rio P

items.title: The Multimodal Anonymizer: a fully local multi-agent AI system for medical data deidentification
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Safe reuse of multimodal hospital data for AI development is limited by the absence of reliable, context-aware deidentification across multimodal data and longitudinal patient data. Existing approaches are largely modality-specific and can indiscriminately remove clinically important information. Methods: We developed the Multimodal Anonymizer, a modular, locally deployable multi-agent framework integrating multimodal large language models, task-specific neural networks and rule-based transformations. We evaluated 16 orchestrator model configurations on a benchmark built from publicly available data and hospital data from our institution. The benchmark dataset included data from different origins: 250 MIMIC-IV patients with synthetically injected personally identifiable information (PII) supplemented with head CT, face images, handwriting, audio, German clinical-text datasets and local data. Primary outcomes were deidentification sensitivity and preservation of clinically important content; secondary analyses examined model characteristics, reproducibility, and performance against leading market and open-source solutions. Results: The best local configuration (the orchestrator being Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking) achieved near-complete deidentification across all datasets, with per-patient sensitivity of 98.80% (95%-CI 97.20; 100), and per-PII sensitivity of 99.82% (95%-CI 99.76; 99.88). Critical clinical preservation was 99.60% (95%-CI 98.80; 100) per-patient, and clinical preservation was 99.61% (95%-CI 99.51; 99.71) per-file. All modalities achieved at least 98.30% sensitivity (lower bound 95%-CI). On our local data, the system achieved a deidentification sensitivity of 100% per-patient and per-PII; and a critical clinical preservation of 100% per-patient as well as a clinical preservation of 99.97% (95%-CI 99.91; 100) per-file. When comparing orchestrators, the leading local models were similar to proprietary models (GPT-5.2) in deidentification sensitivity while showing higher deidentification specificity. The Multimodal Anonymizer outperformed previous tools on most modalities. Conclusion: Near-complete, utility-preserving deidentification of multimodal clinical data is achievable with a unified, locally deployable multi-agent system, enabling safer large-scale reuse of hospital data for research and AI development.
items.summary_zh: 该本地可部署多 Agent 去标识化系统在含 250 名 MIMIC-IV 患者、影像、音频、手写和临床文本的数据基准上，报告高 PII 去除敏感性及临床内容保留率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 多模态、纵向数据去标识化是医院数据再利用的基础能力；结果包含本地数据，但需独立审计其隐私失效模式、实际工作流与跨机构可复现性。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：用于 AI 开发的多模态医院数据的安全再利用，受限于缺乏可靠、具语境意识的多模态和纵向患者数据去标识化方法。现有方法大多是模态特异性的，并可能不加区分地移除具有临床重要性的信息。方法：我们开发了 Multimodal Anonymizer，这是一种模块化、可本地部署的多 Agent 框架，整合多模态大语言模型、任务特异性神经网络和基于规则的转换。我们在由公开数据和本机构医院数据构成的基准上评估了 16 种编排器模型配置。基准数据集包含不同来源的数据：250 名带有合成注入个人可识别信息（PII）的 MIMIC-IV 患者，以及头颅 CT、面部图像、手写、音频、德国临床文本数据集和本地数据。主要结局为去标识化敏感性和具有临床重要性内容的保留；次要分析考察模型特征、可复现性，以及相对于领先商业和开源解决方案的性能。结果：最佳本地配置（编排器为 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking）在所有数据集上实现近乎完全的去标识化，患者级敏感性为 98.80%（95% CI 97.20；100），PII 级敏感性为 99.82%（95% CI 99.76；99.88）。患者级关键临床内容保留率为 99.60%（95% CI 98.80；100），文件级临床内容保留率为 99.61%（95% CI 99.51；99.71）。所有模态的敏感性均至少为 98.30%（95% CI 下限）。在我们的本地数据上，该系统在患者级和 PII 级均达到 100% 的去标识化敏感性；患者级关键临床内容保留率也为 100%，文件级临床内容保留率为 99.97%（95% CI 99.91；100）。比较编排器时，领先的本地模型在去标识化敏感性上与专有模型（GPT-5.2）相近，同时显示更高的去标识化特异性。Multimodal Anonymizer 在多数模态上优于既有工具。结论：通过统一、可本地部署的多 Agent 系统，可以实现近乎完全且保留效用的多模态临床数据去标识化，从而使医院数据能够更安全地大规模再利用于研究和 AI 开发。
items.author_line: Hirsch, A., Ten, F. W., Krueger, K. S., Geyer, R., Roeschl, T., Groeschel, M., Rostin, P., Eils, R., Spott, M., Prasser, F., Meyer, A., Madrid, J.

items.title: Explainable machine learning-assisted differentiation of brucellosis from tuberculosis via routine blood biomarkers
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: To enable low-cost differential diagnosis in primary care settings, we developed a machine-learning model integrating routine clinical indicators and occupational exposure history to discriminate between brucellosis and tuberculosis. Key predictive features were identified via feature selection, and a parsimonious model was subsequently constructed. The model's generalizability was rigorously validated through internal cross-validation and external testing to provide an affordable, practical auxiliary tool for resource-limited primary healthcare. Methods: A retrospective cohort of 273 patients from the Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital affiliated with Xinjiang Medical University was enrolled. After 1:1 propensity score matching, 180 patients (90 with brucellosis, 90 with tuberculosis) were included. Thirty-five clinical variables and occupation were recorded. Four models—logistic regression, support vector machine, random forest (RF), and XGBoost—were developed using 10-fold stratified cross-validation. SHAP analysis identified core features. A three-variable simplified RF model was constructed and validated on an independent temporal test set (n = 42). Results: Among the evaluated algorithms, random forest (RF) achieved the best internal cross-validation performance, with an AUC of 0.9056 ±0.0697, whereas XGBoost exhibited greater variability. SHAP analysis identified occupation, alanine aminotransferase (ALT), and γ-glutamyl transferase (GGT) as the most influential predictors. A simplified RF model incorporating only these three variables yielded a cross-validated AUC of 0.834 ±0.1052. Compared with the full‑feature model, the simplified version retained 92.09% of the original AUC and 97.26% of the sensitivity. Although a minor decrease in accuracy was observed, the McNemar test revealed no statistically significant difference between the two models (P = 0.0776) at the α = 0.05 level. Decision curve analysis showed comparable clinical net benefit. In the external test set, the simplified model attained an AUC of 0.8265 (95% CI: 0.696–0.957), with a sensitivity of 85.71% and a specificity of 71.43%. Conclusion: The three-variable simplified random forest model—incorporating occupation, GGT, and ALT—exhibits robust discrimination in distinguishing brucellosis from tuberculosis. It demonstrates reliable generalizability in external validation and represents a simple, cost-effective diagnostic aid for primary care settings.
items.summary_zh: 该回顾性队列在 273 名患者中开发布鲁氏菌病与结核病鉴别模型；三个变量的简化随机森林在独立时间测试集（n = 42）上 AUC 为 0.8265。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 职业、ALT 和 GGT 构成的简化模型面向资源有限的初级医疗场景，并含时间外部测试；样本量有限，尚不能作为独立诊断工具。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景：为在初级医疗场景中实现低成本鉴别诊断，我们开发了一种机器学习模型，整合常规临床指标和职业暴露史以区分布鲁氏菌病与结核病。通过特征选择识别关键预测特征，随后构建简约模型。通过内部交叉验证和外部测试严格验证模型泛化性，以为资源有限的初级医疗提供一种可负担、实用的辅助工具。方法：纳入新疆医科大学附属中医医院的 273 名患者回顾性队列。经 1:1 倾向评分匹配后，纳入 180 名患者（90 名布鲁氏菌病患者、90 名结核病患者）。记录 35 个临床变量和职业。采用 10 折分层交叉验证开发四种模型——逻辑回归、支持向量机、随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost。SHAP 分析识别核心特征。构建三变量简化 RF 模型，并在独立时间测试集（n = 42）中验证。结果：在评估的算法中，随机森林（RF）取得最佳内部交叉验证性能，AUC 为 0.9056 ± 0.0697，而 XGBoost 的变异性更大。SHAP 分析将职业、丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）和 γ-谷氨酰转移酶（GGT）识别为最有影响的预测因子。仅纳入这三个变量的简化 RF 模型取得交叉验证 AUC 0.834 ± 0.1052。与全特征模型相比，简化版保留了原始 AUC 的 92.09% 和敏感性的 97.26%。尽管准确率略有下降，McNemar 检验显示两个模型在 α = 0.05 水平上无统计学显著差异（P = 0.0776）。决策曲线分析显示相当的临床净获益。在外部测试集中，简化模型达到 AUC 0.8265（95% CI：0.696–0.957），敏感性为 85.71%，特异性为 71.43%。结论：纳入职业、GGT 和 ALT 的三变量简化随机森林模型，在区分布鲁氏菌病与结核病方面显示出稳健的区分能力。其在外部验证中显示可靠泛化性，并可作为初级医疗场景中简单、具有成本效益的诊断辅助工具。
items.author_line: Song W, Zhou J, Xu R, Deng J, Ma J, Yasheng Z, Xiang X, Guo L, Liu Y, Ma X

items.title: EEG-Xplain: Decoding Neural Black-Boxes of EEG Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: EEG foundation models such as BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGMamba have achieved remarkable performance in neural signal decoding, but their black-box nature limits clinical trust and neuroscientific validation. We propose a unified attribution framework for interpreting EEG foundation models across heterogeneous architectures. The framework integrates gradient-, perturbation-, and activation-based explanation methods to analyze model behavior in spatial, temporal, and frequency dimensions. Spatially, it identifies critical EEG channels and visualizes their distributions using topographic maps. Temporally, it highlights decision-relevant signal segments through attribution heatmaps. In the frequency domain, it quantifies the contributions of canonical EEG rhythms via spectral perturbation analysis. To assess explanation reliability, we introduce a population-level evaluation combining Area Over the Perturbation Curve (AOPC) and cross-method consistency analysis. The framework further leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform structured attribution outputs into natural-language reports, bridging low-level neural representations and high-level semantic reasoning. Experiments on benchmark datasets, including Mumtaz2016 and TUAB, demonstrate that the generated explanations are consistent with established neurophysiological markers, validating meaningful neural representations while exposing potential dependencies on artifacts and spurious patterns. The proposed framework provides a standardized approach for evaluating the interpretability, reliability, and physiological plausibility of EEG foundation models.
items.summary_zh: EEG-Xplain 结合梯度、扰动和激活归因，在空间、时间与频率维度解释 EEG 基础模型，并以 AOPC 和跨方法一致性评估解释可靠性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解释框架将神经生理合理性、伪影依赖和模型解释稳定性纳入评估；其临床可信度仍需在真实前瞻性工作流中检验。
items.abstract_zh: BIOT、LaBraM 和 EEGMamba 等 EEG 基础模型在神经信号解码中取得了显著性能，但其黑箱性质限制了临床信任和神经科学验证。我们提出一个统一归因框架，用于解释跨异构架构的 EEG 基础模型。该框架整合基于梯度、扰动和激活的解释方法，以在空间、时间和频率维度分析模型行为。在空间上，它识别关键 EEG 通道，并用拓扑图可视化其分布。在时间上，它通过归因热图突出与决策相关的信号片段。在频率域中，它通过频谱扰动分析量化经典 EEG 节律的贡献。为评估解释可靠性，我们引入将扰动曲线下面积（AOPC）与跨方法一致性分析结合的人群层面评估。该框架还利用大语言模型（LLMs）将结构化归因输出转换为自然语言报告，从而连接低层神经表征和高层语义推理。在包括 Mumtaz2016 和 TUAB 在内的基准数据集上的实验显示，生成的解释与既有神经生理标志物一致，既验证了有意义的神经表征，也暴露了对伪影和虚假模式的潜在依赖。所提框架为评估 EEG 基础模型的可解释性、可靠性和生理合理性提供了标准化方法。

items.title: Evaluating large language models as clinical decision support tools in primary healthcare settings: Protocol for a multi-country comparative validation study on expert-adjudicated hypothetical vignettes (hypMOOVE-PHC)
items.abstract_or_text: Introduction: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to strengthen clinical decision-making in low-resource primary healthcare (PHC) settings. However, most LLMs are developed and benchmarked in high-resource settings and evidence on their safety and contextual appropriateness in Sub-Saharan Africa remains limited. The hypMOOVE-PHC study is the hypothetical vignette phase of the Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation (MOOVE) initiative, implemented in Kenya, Malawi, and Tanzania. It aims to validate a pool of LLMs through clinical review of expert-generated vignettes. Methods and analysis: This is a fully crossed repeated-measures comparative evaluation study. In each country, experienced clinicians develop 200-250 hypothetical clinical vignettes reflecting realistic patient presentations and independently produce a human benchmark care plan for each. Vignettes are used to prompt a selection of six open-source and proprietary LLMs selected based on code availability, local hostability, and model size. During in-person workshops (valiDATAthons), independent clinical experts rate LLM- and human-generated responses in source-attribution masked side-by-side comparisons across five dimensions (clinical soundness, safety, contextual fit, clarity & completeness, and appropriate confidence). The primary endpoints are each LLM's overall performance profile and non-inferior safety profile, as compared to the human benchmark. At minimum, 358 evaluations per LLM (or 1,253 paired evaluations in total) are required per country. Ethics and dissemination: The study is approved by the EPFL Human Ethics Research Committee in Switzerland, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health in the USA, KNH-UoN Ethics and Research Committee in Kenya, MUBAS Research Ethics Committee in Malawi, and MUHAS Research and Ethics Committee and National Institute for Medical Research in Tanzania. Findings will be reported according to the TRIPOD-LLM framework and shared with national ministries of health, disseminated at conferences and in peer-reviewed journals, and de-identified benchmark data will be released under FAIR principles.
items.summary_zh: hypMOOVE-PHC 是肯尼亚、马拉维和坦桑尼亚的多国临床评估方案：每国拟建立 200–250 个专家病例情景，并比较六个 LLM 与人工照护方案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方案以盲化、专家裁定和情境适配性评估补足低资源初级医疗中的证据缺口，并计划 FAIR 数据发布；目前是 protocol，尚未报告任何模型的临床性能或安全性结果。
items.abstract_zh: 引言：大语言模型（LLMs）有望加强资源有限的初级医疗（PHC）场景中的临床决策。然而，大多数 LLM 在高资源环境中开发和基准测试，关于其在撒哈拉以南非洲的安全性和情境适宜性的证据仍有限。hypMOOVE-PHC 研究是 Massive Open Online Validation and Evaluation（MOOVE）倡议的假设病例情景阶段，在肯尼亚、马拉维和坦桑尼亚实施。它旨在通过对专家生成病例情景的临床审查，验证一组 LLM。方法与分析：这是一项完全交叉、重复测量的比较评估研究。在每个国家，经验丰富的临床医生将开发 200–250 个反映真实患者表现的假设临床病例情景，并独立为每个情景制定人工基准照护计划。病例情景用于提示基于代码可用性、本地主机部署能力和模型规模选定的六个开源和专有 LLM。在面对面工作坊（valiDATAthons）期间，独立临床专家在来源归属被遮蔽的并排比较中，从五个维度对 LLM 和人工生成的回答评分：临床合理性、安全性、情境适配性、清晰度与完整性，以及恰当的置信度。主要终点是每个 LLM 的总体性能图谱以及相对于人工基准的非劣安全性图谱。每个国家每个 LLM 至少需要 358 次评估（或总计 1,253 次配对评估）。伦理与传播：本研究已获瑞士 EPFL Human Ethics Research Committee、美国 Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health、肯尼亚 KNH-UoN Ethics and Research Committee、马拉维 MUBAS Research Ethics Committee、坦桑尼亚 MUHAS Research and Ethics Committee 及 National Institute for Medical Research 批准。研究结果将按 TRIPOD-LLM 框架报告，并与各国卫生部共享，在会议和同行评议期刊上传播；去标识化基准数据将依 FAIR 原则发布。
items.author_line: Macharia, P., Kachimanga, C., Mahende, M. K., Mapunda, E., Sonnay, Y., Ntracha, A., Woodbury, S., Inwani, I., Otieno, F., Sawe, H. R., Kumwenda, S., Mhalu, G., Essuman, W., Elhassan, F., Duron, B., Henriet, M., Azgaoui, O. Z., Rousset, V., Ahumuza, P., Foer, K. items.title: HypoKG: Evidence-Disciplined Biomedical Hypothesis Generation Beyond Endpoint Knowledge
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) can generate biomedical hypotheses, but it remains unclear whether they truly reason from scientific evidence or simply produce convincing-sounding ideas. To study this, we combine three major biological databases: the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Rhea, and UniProt, into a unified biochemical knowledge graph and construct a benchmark of 550 paths connecting enzyme sources to rare disease endpoints, yielding 13,200 hypotheses from six LLMs under four conditions varying the biological information each model receives: source enzyme only, full biological path, or source and disease endpoint only. Hypotheses are scored using an expert-derived five-criterion rubric on a 1-5 scale per criterion. We find that models given both the source and disease endpoint often produce the highest-scoring hypotheses, showing that LLMs can generate compelling ideas from minimal information. However, these hypotheses are less grounded in the evidence. In contrast, models given the full biological path generate hypotheses more consistent with known mechanistic relationships. We call this evidence-disciplined reasoning. To confirm this effect, we shuffled intermediate path steps while keeping endpoints fixed. Evidence grounding dropped significantly (delta = -0.793, p < 0.001), confirming models genuinely used path structure during reasoning. Our findings show that knowledge graphs support hypothesis generation in two ways: they identify biological endpoint pairs absent from the literature, and their mechanistic paths guide how LLMs reason between them.
items.summary_zh: HypoKG 整合 KEGG、Rhea 和 UniProt，构建 550 条酶源至罕见病终点路径，并以 13,200 个假设检验 LLM 使用机制路径而非仅利用终点信息的程度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究用路径打乱实验量化证据锚定，为生物医学假设生成的可审计性提供基准；专家量表和知识图谱路径一致性不等同于假设已获实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）能够生成生物医学假设，但尚不清楚它们是否真正依据科学证据推理，还是仅产生听起来可信的想法。为研究这一问题，我们将三个主要生物数据库——Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes（KEGG）、Rhea 和 UniProt——合并为统一的生化知识图谱，并构建一个由 550 条路径组成的基准，这些路径连接酶来源与罕见病终点；在四种条件下、由六个 LLM 生成 13,200 个假设，条件根据每个模型获得的生物学信息而变化：仅提供来源酶、提供完整生物学路径，或仅提供来源和疾病终点。使用专家制定的五项标准量表对假设评分，每项标准采用 1–5 分。我们发现，同时获得来源和疾病终点的模型常生成得分最高的假设，表明 LLM 可从最少信息生成看似有说服力的想法。然而，这些假设较少扎根于证据。相比之下，获得完整生物学路径的模型生成的假设与已知机制关系更一致。我们将其称为证据约束推理。为确认这一效应，我们在保持终点固定的同时打乱中间路径步骤。证据锚定显著下降（delta = -0.793，p < 0.001），证实模型确实在推理中使用了路径结构。我们的发现表明，知识图谱以两种方式支持假设生成：它们识别文献中尚不存在的生物学终点对，其机制路径则引导 LLM 如何在二者之间推理。
items.author_line: Dominic Okonkwo, Adetayo Okunoye, Ismailcem Budak Arpinar

items.title: RAGCell: Retrieval-Augmented Generation as Supervision for Versatile Single-cell Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell foundation models (scFMs) are transforming computational biology by enabling generalizable, task-agnostic representations for versatile single-cell analysis. Despite their progress in facilitating rapid deployment for downstream tasks, off-the-shelf scFMs still have some overlooked concerns: (I) (Pretraining Cost.) Pretrain-based scFMs necessitate pretraining on a vast volume of cells, rendering it draining resources in applications. (II) (Heterogeneous Gap.) Large Language Models (LLM)-based scFMs ignore the tremendous heterogeneous gap between LLM textual and raw cellular spaces, leading to insufficient capability when facing downstream tasks. To this end, we introduce RAGCell, a versatile single-cell analysis framework that achieves a double-win in both cost-effectiveness and high performance. The success of RAGCell lies in two key aspects: Leveraging LLMs to construct cell-level and feature-level knowledge databases, which serve as supervision signals for training the cell model and significantly reduce the training cost (>pretrain-based scFMs). Aligning cell representations with text embeddings from the bi-level knowledge databases, enabling knowledge transfer from textual spaces to cellular spaces and effectively mitigating the heterogeneous gap (>LLM-based scFMs). Through extensive experiments on six downstream single-cell analysis tasks, we demonstrate that RAGCell achieves outstanding performance compared to state-of-the-art scFMs while operating at less than \sim1/10 the cost of pretrain-based scFMs.
items.summary_zh: RAGCell 以 LLM 构建细胞级和特征级知识库作为监督信号，并将细胞表征与文本嵌入对齐；作者在六项下游单细胞任务中报告其性能优于现有 scFM。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试以检索增强监督降低单细胞基础模型的预训练成本并缩小文本—细胞表征鸿沟；成本与性能主张目前来自预印本基准，需独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基础模型（scFMs）正通过为通用单细胞分析提供可泛化、任务无关的表征而改变计算生物学。尽管它们促进了下游任务的快速部署，现成的 scFMs 仍有一些被忽视的问题：（I）（预训练成本。）基于预训练的 scFMs 需要在大量细胞上预训练，使其在应用中消耗大量资源。（II）（异质性鸿沟。）基于大语言模型（LLM）的 scFMs 忽略了 LLM 文本空间与原始细胞空间之间巨大的异质性鸿沟，在面对下游任务时导致能力不足。为此，我们引入 RAGCell，这是一种通用单细胞分析框架，在成本效益和高性能两方面实现双赢。RAGCell 的成功在于两个关键方面：利用 LLM 构建细胞级和特征级知识数据库，将其作为训练细胞模型的监督信号，并显著降低训练成本（优于基于预训练的 scFMs）。将来自双层知识数据库的文本嵌入与细胞表征对齐，使知识可从文本空间迁移至细胞空间，并有效缓解异质性鸿沟（优于基于 LLM 的 scFMs）。通过在六项下游单细胞分析任务上进行广泛实验，我们表明 RAGCell 相比最先进 scFMs 取得突出性能，同时其运行成本低于基于预训练 scFMs 的约 1/10。
items.author_line: Tianyu Liu, Fan Zhang, Jiayuan Chen, Kun Wang, Haoxuan Li, Shengju Qian, Zhihong Zhu, Donghao Zhou, Hao Wu, Ziheng Zhang, Zhenxi Lin, Xian Wu, Yefeng Zheng

review.note: 审阅完整 60 项候选后选出 12 项；均为 preprint，未将模型性能、组学关联或体外功能结果表述为临床有效性或因果结论。覆盖蛋白质与结构、组学与细胞、生物医学与临床、方法与模型。
